mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_category WHERE name = #{name} AND status = 'ENABLED' LIMIT 1
SELECT category_id FROM t_breed WHERE id = #{breedId}
SELECT id FROM t_farm WHERE deleted = 0 AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
SELECT id FROM t_user WHERE status = 'NORMAL' AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

SELECT DISTINCT a.id FROM t_admin a JOIN t_admin_permission p ON p.perm_code = #{permission} LEFT JOIN t_admin_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = a.role_id AND rp.permission_id = p.id WHERE a.status = 'NORMAL' AND (a.role_id = 1 OR rp.id IS NOT NULL)
